artifact_observations.reasoning: The text within the UI icons and header bar is illegible and lacks coherent character structure, appearing as blurry glyphs rather than sharp alphanumeric characters. This is a common AI artifact in rendering small text.
The individual keys lack distinct mechanical separation or shadow gaps between them; they appear slightly fused or 'melted' into the base plate, lacking the crisp edges of real molded plastic keys.

The connection point between the screen unit and the keyboard slider on the right side is geometrically ambiguous. The silver trim warps and blends into the white casing without a clear mechanical hinge or seam logic.
